item.title: Morning Weather for Monday, August 31
item.description: Good morning! It's Monday, August 31. Time for the weather! Monday again. Let's start the week well! Shanghai is going to be rumbling with thunderstorms today. The high will be 32 degrees, and the low will be 26 degrees. The chance of rain is 85 percent. Remember to take an umbrella with you! Take your raincoat with you. Splashing is allowed! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be thundery, reaching 31 degrees. A question for you: what are you looking forward to? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
